title: Entering through a terminal or an agent
situations: A human runs the installer in a terminal
A human tells an existing agent: install upyoke.com
Installation stops halfway or changes presentation mode
current: Observed installer campaign baseline: PATH checks passed; the isolated welcome frame displayed the authored identity and uv attempt, then refused its unwritable home. The prior case incorrectly expected successful exit. Full install and live-agent delivery remain unproven.
questions: Can an agent with no Yoke-specific context complete the exact public entry path?
Does every failure preserve enough context to resume without guessing?
